delivered.backend: GET /api/workspaces/diff reads HEAD (empty tree when no first commit) as the old side and the final local file as the new side, merging staged and unstaged content; supports added/deleted/renamed (oldPath) and conflicted changes. Both sides independently apply preview_limit_bytes before loading content; binary/too-large sides set complete:false with explicit reasons. Both new and old paths go through the shared workspace root-boundary validation, including links, junctions, traversal, absolute paths, and root replacement. Uses only git ls-tree/cat-file and read-only browse reads.
delivered.frontend: Change list is selectable; desktop shows left list + right diff, default side-by-side; narrow shows unified diff with explicit back and exact list-scroll restore. Selection, diff, and scroll survive internal browse/changes view and top-level tab round trips. Diff rows are rendered as text nodes only; over-limit/binary changes remain visible, colored, and counted.
